data.title: Novartis Pelacarsen Fails to Cut Cardiovascular Events in Key Phase III Lp(a) Trial
data.description:
Novartis ( (NVS) ) has provided an announcement.

On September 4, 2026, Novartis reported topline Phase III results from its Lp(a)HORIZON trial evaluating pelacarsen in 8,323 patients with elevated lipoprotein(a) and established cardiovascular disease. The study, a major outcomes trial, did not meet its primary endpoint, as lowering Lp(a) with pelacarsen failed to significantly reduce a composite of cardiovascular death, non‑fatal myocardial infarction, non‑fatal stroke and urgent coronary revascularization versus placebo.

Pelacarsen, an investigational antisense oligonucleotide licensed from Ionis Pharmaceuticals, did achieve substantial Lp(a) reductions in patients already receiving guideline‑directed lipid‑lowering and antihypertensive therapy. However, the lack of demonstrated event‑risk reduction in this optimized‑care population challenges expectations for Lp(a)‑targeted drugs and may influence future development strategies, while still offering valuable scientific insight into the complex link between genetic Lp(a) elevation and cardiovascular outcomes.
